text_block_list.text:
One day, after finishing training with <chrname>, I 
was writing a summary of the day in my 
notebook when—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: —Excuse me. Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Pardon the sudden intrusion. I happened to 
see your training, and there was something 
I wished to ask.

Scouting out <chrname>!? No, she's standing right 
out in the open... Let's hear what she has 
to say first.
choice_data_list:
I might not be able to answer 
everything... but is that alright?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. First, I apologize for 
appearing to spy on you.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
From training posture to trajectory 
correction. It was a lesson so riveting I 
couldn't look away.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: So please, by all means, enlighten me――

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
What do you keep in mind when instructing 
Umamusume?
choice_data_list: Wait, you want to know how I teach?
Wait, you want to know how I teach?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. As someone aiming to become an 
instructor in the future, I would love to 
hear it.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Day in and day out, I accumulate knowledge 
like this――

Peeking inside the notebook labeled 
"Guidance Curriculum," I caught a glimpse 
of densely packed, meticulous handwriting. 
That alone spoke volumes about how serious 
she is...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
, I want to pass down my learnings and 
experience to those who follow after me.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
To do so, just running isn't enough. I 
want to learn words that truly 
communicate, and proper coaching methods.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
To weave the history of Umamusume and 
build a glorious future.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Please, share your thoughts with me from a 
mentor's perspective. !

I'm still only halfway along my own path, 
so I don't have much wisdom to offer. Even 
so, I'll leave behind a few words for the 
trainers of tomorrowâ
choice_data_list:
I guess I just try not to get 
overconfident in myself!

I make a conscious effort to keep myself 
disciplined.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I see... Pride is the ultimate adversary, 
just like when running in a race.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yet if my words sound uncertain, it will 
only make my student anxious... It is a 
difficult balance to strike.

I took out a notebook and showed it to 
her. Inside were notes on everything I'd 
learned from my senior trainers and 
instructional guidebooks.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The amount of notes is on a completely 
different level from mine……! To still 
study this hard, even now……
choice_data_list:
If we keep this up, we won't get 
overconfident.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I see... What is truly important is never 
forgetting to approach learning with 
humility.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep taking notes too. Filling the 
pages so densely you won't beat me!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: You mean engaging in self-reflection?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Even if I were sleep-deprived, for 
instance, the information conveyed would 
remain identical, wouldn't it?
choice_data_list:
Still, you can't preach health management 
in that state.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
!! Indeed, it lacks all shred of 
persuasion...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I see... Even rational instruction is 
meaningless without the proper mindset to 
support it...
choice_data_list:
I think that's the first step to reaching 
people.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I think I'm starting to understand why I 
was drawn to your guidance.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much. I will carry everything 
I learned today into the future!
